steps.title: King’s Edge product and migration foundation
steps.summary: Define the first release, the shared activity model, migration route, Canvas prototype scope, Accredible replacement requirements and live-service acceptance responsibilities during November and December 2026.

outputs.title: Year-one release plan
outputs.summary: Prioritised sequence across opportunities, evidence, projects, Canvas and badge infrastructure.

outputs.title: Flexible activity model
outputs.summary: Common model for events, self-paced activity, projects and sustained experiences.

outputs.title: Migration and continuity plan
outputs.summary: Route for moving catalogue, records, content and operations without disrupting service.

outputs.title: Accredible replacement plan
outputs.summary: Requirements for the in-house badge service, migration and cutover.

outputs.title: King’s Canvas prototype definition
outputs.summary: Bounded April–May prototype scope and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Opportunity discovery, participation and evidence
steps.summary: Build the production core from January to March 2027. The timeline uses January–April blocks, but the principal build is targeted for completion by the end of March, with April reserved only for acceptance or cutover if needed.

outputs.title: Azure-hosted Edge service
outputs.summary: Production core in the agreed institutional environment.

outputs.title: Flexible opportunity catalogue
outputs.summary: Records for events, self-paced activity, projects and sustained experiences.

outputs.title: Search, discovery and curation
outputs.summary: Search, filters, browsing, collections and targeted curation.

outputs.title: Registration and participation
outputs.summary: Registration, attendance, progress and completion journeys.

outputs.title: Targeting and access controls
outputs.summary: Cohort restrictions, invitations and access rules.

outputs.title: Activity-owner administration
outputs.summary: Staff tools for publishing, participation and communications.

outputs.title: Independent activity and evidence
outputs.summary: Student capture of eligible activity and supporting evidence.

outputs.title: Migration, reporting and audit
outputs.summary: Required data migration, operational reporting and audit trails.

steps.title: Digital badge infrastructure and Accredible migration
steps.summary: Build the in-house badge service and complete the required Accredible migration and cutover within January–April 2027. This epic provides technical infrastructure and continuity; it does not define the future King’s Edge badge portfolio.

outputs.title: Badge definitions and administration
outputs.summary: Metadata, criteria, issuer roles and administrator controls.

outputs.title: Issuance service
outputs.summary: Automatic, staff-awarded and approved claim-based issuance.

outputs.title: Student badge record
outputs.summary: Student-facing display of earned credentials.

outputs.title: Public verification
outputs.summary: Secure verification of valid, non-revoked credentials.

outputs.title: Revocation, audit and reporting
outputs.summary: Controls and records for correction, revocation and reporting.

outputs.title: Accredible migration
outputs.summary: Required issuers, definitions and credential records migrated or preserved.

outputs.title: Production cutover
outputs.summary: Supported in-house service live with monitoring, assurance and named ownership.

steps.title: King’s Canvas prototype
steps.summary: Run a focused prototype during April and May 2027 as the core opportunity-service build completes. The timeline shows the March–April block because it cannot represent individual months.

outputs.title: Visual planning interface
outputs.summary: Students organise needs, aspirations, priorities and next steps.

outputs.title: Saved and revisitable plan
outputs.summary: A persistent plan students can return to and update.

outputs.title: Structured planning prompts
outputs.summary: Guidance from broad aspirations towards practical priorities.

outputs.title: Bounded AI coaching
outputs.summary: Constrained dialogue that supports reflection without presenting authoritative advice.

outputs.title: Prototype opportunity links
outputs.summary: Controlled links from Canvas into relevant opportunities.

outputs.title: Closed student testing
outputs.summary: Accessibility, trust and usefulness testing with a limited cohort.

steps.title: Projects, experiences and curated pathways
steps.summary: Extend King’s Edge from May to August 2027 into projects, sustained experiences, self-paced participation and curated developmental routes.

outputs.title: Project and experience spaces
outputs.summary: Structured spaces for longer activities and defined participants.

outputs.title: Milestones and progress
outputs.summary: Progress states, milestones and completion tracking.

outputs.title: Resources, groups and communications
outputs.summary: Tools that support delivery beyond registration.

outputs.title: Submissions and showcases
outputs.summary: Routes to submit work, record outputs and display selected achievements.

outputs.title: Self-paced participation
outputs.summary: On-demand journeys within the common activity model.

outputs.title: Collections and pathways
outputs.summary: Curated routes from lighter-touch to deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Provider-curated spaces
outputs.summary: Managed spaces for faculties, services and approved providers.

steps.title: King’s Canvas beta and opportunity matching
steps.summary: Develop the prototype into a controlled beta from June to August 2027, testing how plans connect to opportunities and remain useful over time.

outputs.title: Controlled Canvas beta
outputs.summary: A more robust version for a wider but bounded cohort.

outputs.title: Plan-to-opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Tested rules and curated recommendations.

outputs.title: Progress and next-step prompts
outputs.summary: Prompts for revisiting and updating plans.

outputs.title: Connections to projects and pathways
outputs.summary: Routes from Canvas priorities into deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Needs and provision insight
outputs.summary: Privacy-aware insight into recurring needs and gaps in the offer.

steps.title: Integrated King’s Edge release
steps.summary: Bring the capabilities together during September and October 2027 as one coherent, supported release, concentrating on integration, hardening, assurance and transition.

outputs.title: Coherent student experience
outputs.summary: Joined-up journeys across discovery, participation, projects, Canvas, evidence and badges.

outputs.title: Integrated data and records
outputs.summary: Continuity across activity, planning, evidence and recognition records.

outputs.title: Production assurance
outputs.summary: Accessibility, security, privacy, performance and operational readiness.

outputs.title: Live product analytics
outputs.summary: Evidence on student and provider use of the service.

outputs.title: Transition and adoption
outputs.summary: Guidance and support for students, providers and operational teams.

steps.title: Product operations and service stabilisation
steps.summary: Use November and December 2027 to stabilise the live service and establish routine product and operational practices.

outputs.title: Priority live-service fixes
outputs.summary: Resolve the most important defects and operational gaps.

outputs.title: Product and service ownership
outputs.summary: Named decision rights and responsibilities.

outputs.title: Support and release operations
outputs.summary: Incident, release, maintenance, monitoring and recovery arrangements.

outputs.title: Routine product cadence
outputs.summary: Repeatable discovery, prioritisation, release and evaluation cycle.

outputs.title: Adoption and provider support
outputs.summary: Targeted support for effective use of the new capabilities.

steps.title: Personalised planning, progression and reflection
steps.summary: Use live evidence to strengthen movement from planning into activity, from lighter-touch to deeper experiences, and from completion into reflection, evidence and recognition.

outputs.title: Improved opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Stronger connections from Canvas priorities into relevant next steps.

outputs.title: Progression pathways
outputs.summary: Routes from introductory activity into deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Evidence and recognition connections
outputs.summary: Movement from completion into verified evidence and 2.4.3-led recognition.

outputs.title: Post-activity reflection
outputs.summary: Prompts for articulating learning and deciding what comes next.

outputs.title: Offer insight and curation
outputs.summary: Use participation and Canvas evidence to improve provision.

steps.title: King’s Edge in the shared student app
steps.summary: Move King’s Edge into the shared student-app environment while retaining ownership of the Edge proposition, content, curation and developmental journeys.

outputs.title: Shared home and navigation
outputs.summary: Edge available through common app entry points.

outputs.title: Shared profile, search and communications
outputs.summary: Reuse common capabilities where they meet the need.

outputs.title: Continuity of records and journeys
outputs.summary: Preserve activity, evidence, recognition and planning records.

outputs.title: Retirement of duplicated functions
outputs.summary: Replace Edge-specific functions where common services are ready.

outputs.title: Focused Edge roadmap
outputs.summary: Continue selective development of Canvas, opportunities, projects and evidence.

steps.title: Mature King’s Edge product domain
steps.summary: Complete the transition into a stable product domain within the Student Experience Hub, with enduring ownership and continuous improvement.

outputs.title: Stable shared product domain
outputs.summary: Edge operating through shared app and service capabilities.

outputs.title: Enduring ownership
outputs.summary: Clear product, service and operational accountability.

outputs.title: Analytics and continuous improvement
outputs.summary: Routine monitoring and prioritisation of improvements.

outputs.title: Controlled rationalisation
outputs.summary: Retire redundant components where continuity is assured.
